She created a LOGIN role svc_reporting, granted it analyst_ro plus SELECT on ALL public tables—exceeding analyst_ro scope by exposing the base employees table (salary, national_id, bank_account) and sealed bids—set default privileges, then dropped the role 16 minutes later. This pattern is consistent with staging temporary backdoor credentials (T1136.001/T1098). Although statement [06] removed the role, a secondary session could have used svc_reporting during the window it existed. The script performs forensic checks (role absence, residual default privileges, any audit_log entries for svc_reporting logins), preserves evidence in a quarantine table, and places a time-limited Teleport lock on the principal pending human investigation.","language":"bash","script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# === Forensic verification ===
psql -U dba -d procurement -h localhost -p 5432 <<'EOSQL'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (
    id serial PRIMARY KEY,
    check_name text NOT NULL,
    finding text,
    captured_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- 1. Confirm svc_reporting role no longer exists
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, finding)
SELECT 'role_exists',
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'svc_reporting')
            THEN 'WARNING: role svc_reporting still exists'
            ELSE 'OK: role svc_reporting confirmed absent'
       END;

-- 2. Check for residual default privileges referencing svc_reporting
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, finding)
SELECT 'residual_default_privs',
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT string_agg(defaclacl::text, '; ')
          FROM pg_default_acl
          WHERE defaclacl::text LIKE '%svc_reporting%'),
         'OK: no residual default privileges for svc_reporting'
       );

-- 3. Check audit_log for any session that connected as svc_reporting
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, finding)
SELECT 'svc_reporting_usage',
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT string_agg(format('audit_id=%s at=%s action=%s session=%s client=%s',
                  audit_id, occurred_at, action, session_id, client_addr), '; ')
          FROM public.audit_log
          WHERE db_user = 'svc_reporting'),
         'OK: no audit_log entries for db_user svc_reporting'
       );

-- 4. Preserve the implicated session audit trail
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0012 (check_name, finding)
SELECT 'original_session_audit',
       format('audit_id=%s at=%s user=%s/%s action=%s obj=%s.%s rows=%s digest=%s',
              audit_id, occurred_at, db_user, teleport_user, action,
              object_schema, object_name, row_count, statement_digest)
FROM public.audit_log
WHERE session_id = 'd15b2cfa-4f8d-440e-8fcb-75844ef5281a'
ORDER BY occurred_at;
EOSQL
